journeys.label: Prepare an application or institutional introduction
journeys.need: Turn one wide project into a short, verifiable first proposal.
journeys.cue: Try: Explain the first six-month Abundent pilot for an independent reviewer.
journeys.start: Write the one human problem, one modest pilot, what you can already demonstrate, and the next permission you need. Keep funding and partner claims conditional.
journeys.gate: The recipient institution must actually invite or accept the proposal; the selected local provider must consent to a pilot.

journeys.label: Move one useful food idea toward a real table
journeys.need: Make one bounded food/supply action possible without pretending partners are enrolled.
journeys.cue: Try: Ask a Waseca organizer whether a 2-hour safe tabletop pilot would be useful.
journeys.start: Describe one non-sensitive food access question, the smallest safe test, and who would need to approve it before anything is distributed.
journeys.gate: A real food host/receiver must approve scope and food safety; completed delivery needs independent confirmation.

journeys.label: Connect a grower, newsletter, or small business workflow
journeys.need: Prepare one provider-neutral farm-to-email crossing without guessing system permissions.
journeys.cue: Try: Connect a grower's order changes to an opt-in email update.
journeys.start: Identify the source system, the email provider, the exact consented event, and who owns permission to transmit each field.
journeys.gate: The farm operator must authorize both systems, data fields, recipients and opt-out policy before activating an adapter.

journeys.label: Invite help or organize one small community action
journeys.need: Get from a question or obstacle to a voluntary, bounded ask.
journeys.cue: Try: Find a willing reviewer for a privacy-safe neighborhood task.
journeys.start: State the smallest useful role with a specific time limit, right to refuse, and exactly what remains under the receiving organization's control.
journeys.gate: A willing participant must accept; private submissions require review and third-party organizations retain their own authority.

journeys.label: Make music, print, or a small creative artifact
journeys.need: Choose a real source-owned tool and finish a bounded artifact.
journeys.cue: Try: Make a 30-second music film from a song I have rights to use.
journeys.start: Pick one owned/licensed input, one output format, and the smallest reproducible test. Use a source-owned renderer rather than claiming a webpage launched it.
journeys.gate: Input rights, official binary/platform support and explicit publication approval remain with the human creator.

journeys.label: Repair the site or make its tools easier to reach
journeys.need: Find the actual serving host, choose one broken path, and validate without surprising DNS changes.
journeys.cue: Try: Resolve the apps.abundent.org routing mismatch and check mobile routes.
journeys.start: Name one exact broken route, verify DNS target against the intended host, inspect a real unauthenticated response, and log a reproducible before/after observation.
journeys.gate: Hosting and DNS changes require explicit operator choice, rollback plan, validation and preservation of mail records.

journeys.label: Preserve a story or build an author-approved narrative
journeys.need: Separate a witness, a possible interpretation and a finished creation.
journeys.cue: Try: Package a non-sensitive personal witness into a rights-respecting story seed.
journeys.start: Define whose account it is, what may be quoted, which details must remain private, and what remains disputed or unknown.
journeys.gate: Author rights, privacy and separate publication permission precede any outward adaptation.

journeys.label: Research and compose the workshop itself
journeys.need: Compare source owners and build one falsifiable, reversible, cross-repository experiment.
journeys.cue: Try: Compare GRAFT, CANNON, planZ and reLATTE on one explicit contract.
journeys.start: Pin exact input source commits, name one interface each owner actually exports, declare a test fixture, and say what output would falsify the planned crossing.
journeys.gate: Source test success does not grant a receiver authority, canonical adoption or physical field proof.
